about_the_game:
CAR ROBOT Market Simulator Modavuj Multiplayer

This is a fun business simulation where you build and grow your own market. Starting with a small shop, you'll deal with the whims of monster customers, stock the shelves, set prices, and ultimately strive to grow into a massive grocery empire!

So, what awaits you?

🛒 Shelf Management – ​​Don't leave the shelves empty, or customers will look at you like, "Is this a market or a warehouse?"

💸 Price Setting – Sell cheaply, and customers will be happy. Sell expensively, and your coffers will fill up. But be careful, overdoing it will make you trend on social media.

👥 Customer Relations – Clear the queue quickly and avoid impatient customers grumbling at the door.

📦 Inventory Management – ​​Don't let products run out; keep track of suppliers. Otherwise, customers will leave empty-handed.

🏗️ Market Expansion – Progress from a small market to a giant supermarket. Open new shelves and sell more products.

🎯 Your Own Strategy – Whether you're a "cheap hero" or a "high-priced but prestigious" seller, this is your market, the decision is yours!

Are you ready? There's only one truth in this world: Empty shelves mean a worn-out customer. 😂
